name: ForwardEmail
description: Forwards an existing email message using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: mailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: The mailbox containing the message to forward.

fields.name: messageId
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The Microsoft Graph message identifier of the email to forward.

fields.name: appendSubject
fields.label: Append to Existing Subject
fields.description: If enabled, the provided subject is appended to the original email subject. Otherwise, it replaces the existing subject.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: Optional. Specify a new subject or text to append to the existing subject.

fields.name: comment
fields.label: Comment
fields.description: Optional message to include above the forwarded email.

fields.name: toRecipients
fields.label: To Recipients
fields.description: One or more recipient email addresses separated by semicolons (;).

fields.name: cc
fields.label: CC
fields.description: One or more CC recipient email addresses, separated by semicolons (;).

fields.name: bcc
fields.label: BCC
fields.description: One or more BCC recipient email addresses, separated by semicolons (;).

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the status of the forward operation.
